name: Dry Bar Comedy
description: The worlds largest collection of clean stand-up. Always clever. Always clean.

videos.title: Tom Clark: I'm a Rescue
videos.overview: Tom Clark was born and raised, in that order. Clark’s mix of well-crafted jokes and spontaneous crowd work has led to appearances on TBS’s, Conan, CBS’s Late Late Show, and Comedy Central’s Premium Blend.

videos.title: Drew Allen: Out of Ideas
videos.overview: Cursed with the ability to over-analyze even the most basic of human interactions, comedian Drew Allen has been delighting audiences with his distinct brand of anxious comedy since 2010.

videos.title: Heath Harmison: Raising Insanity
videos.overview: Heath is one of the brightest new comedians out there. His family-friendly style of comedy kills in clubs, colleges, and festivals including the Fringe Festival in Edinburgh, Scotland.

videos.title: Karen Rontowski: Ridiculous Me
videos.overview: Karen Rontowski's fast-paced, quirky and charmingly optimistic comedy has been featured in clubs, TV, radio, and at corporate events all around the world.

videos.title: Don Friesen: Live in Provo
videos.overview: Husband. Idiot. Dad. His kids think he’s fun. His wife thinks he’s an idiot. Audiences think he’s hilarious!

videos.title: Bengt Washburn: Poking A Grizzly
videos.overview: Bengt Washburn is an Aquarius with Hazel eyes who prefers boxer briefs, solid deodorants, and Crest toothpaste.

videos.title: Steve Soelberg: We Say Bim
videos.overview: Comedian Steve Soelberg presents his personal blend of observational comedy and storytelling, relating his experiences of growing up in a large Seattle family alongside funny anecdotes and jokes.

videos.title: Lamont Ferguson: You Had All Day
videos.overview: Ferguson has appeared on the Tonight Show, Comedy Central, Comics Unleashed and ABC's Family Channel. He was the Winner of the Seattle International Comedy Competition, Three time semi-finalist at the Boston Comedy Festival, Finalist in the San Francisco International Comedy Competition and named Best of Fest" at the Detroit, Lucky Eagle and San Luis Obispo Comedy Festivals.

videos.title: Bone Hampton: It Is What It Is
videos.overview: As down home as collards and cornbread, as sharp as a pickaxe, and as funny as a possum in a petticoat, Comedian Bone Hampton is a master at making audiences feel like family.

videos.title: Jenna Kim Jones: Fun To Hug
videos.overview: Jenna Kim Jones is a comedian known for her strong personality and little to no upper body strength. She recently came to grips with the fact that she will never be able to do a pull up and earn her 4th grade Presidential Fitness Award though she plans to exploit this limitation into a book or reality television deal.

videos.title: Brad Upton: Will Be Funny For Money
videos.overview: Brad Upton first stepped on stage in September of 1984 and he's never looked back. This ex-grade school teacher is now in his 30th year of comedy and is nearing 6000 lifetime performances.

videos.title: Dwight Slade: Animal Cracker
videos.overview: Part man, part ageless boy; comedian Dwight Slade has the privilege of being a comedy legend in American stand up.

videos.title: Kellen Erskine: Composed
videos.overview: Kellen Erskine was featured on season 7 of NBC’s America’s Got Talent. His jokes have appeared in many publications including the Reader’s Digest.

videos.title: Alex Velluto: Spurious
videos.overview: In Alex Velluto's debut comedy special, he discusses his frustrations with relationships, dating, food, and goes over some "spurious correlations" and data in a hilarious routine with flip charts.

videos.title: Kermet Apio: There's No I in Self Esteem
videos.overview: Born and raised in Honolulu, Hawaii, Kermet Apio enjoyed a childhood in paradise. He spent his time watching television, playing, and procrastinating everything else.

videos.title: David Crowe: White Bread
videos.overview: David Crowe is a 20 year veteran of the comedy stage. After winning both the Seattle and San Francisco Comedy Competitions, then performing for a US President the same year, his career took off and has never stopped.

videos.title: Robert Mac: Know More
videos.overview: Robert's award-winning comedy is smart, subtle, and silly. Not too smart and not too subtle, but occasionally a bit more silly than you'd expect.

videos.title: Brian Moote: Getting Schooled
videos.overview: Brian Moote started performing stand up in 2005 while he was working as a teacher in the Seattle School District.

videos.title: The Comedy And Magic Of Brad Bonar
videos.overview: Brad is a double threat. One of the most talented magicians in the country, he is also a very gifted and funny stand-up comedian in The Comedy and Magic of Brad Bonar.

videos.title: Mary Mack: All Ages
videos.overview: Folk Humorist Mary Mack performs her sometimes-musical comedy at festivals, colleges, clubs, casinos and anywhere you can find a llama or a buffet line.

videos.title: Billy Anderson: America's Sweetheart
videos.overview: Born in Texas and raised in Augusta, Georgia – Billy Anderson is a stand-up comedian currently living in Seattle, Washington.

videos.title: Russ Nagel: Uncle of Anarchy
videos.overview: Russ has become recognized in the entertainment industry for achieving more laughs per minute than any comedian working the circuit today and has also been seen on The Nashville Network, A&E's Comedy on the Road, Showtime's Comedy Club Network, the WB, Spike TV, Comedy Central and the list goes on and on.

videos.title: Dennis Gaxiola: Before The Wall Goes Up
videos.overview: Dennis Gaxiola is one of America's funniest clean comedians. The preacher's son gained notoriety from his appearances with Jamie Foxx on Comedy Central, The Latin Kings of Comedy Tour with Paul Rodriguez, BET's Comic View, Que Locos and the 2010 season Martin Lawrence's First Amendment Stand Up.

videos.title: Michael Joiner: God's Smart Alec
videos.overview: Michael's brand of comedy is, in a word, familiar. Not in the sense that you've heard it before, but more so that he knows you and you know him.

videos.title: Jason Hewlett: Father Time
videos.overview: The Award-Winning One-Man Show of Jason Hewlett The Entertainer will have you laughing until it hurts. Comedy, Music, Impressions, and Standing Ovations make Jason the perfect entertainer.

videos.title: Christian Pieper: Glutton for Punishment
videos.overview: Christian Pieper is an award-winning and crowd-pleasing comedian from Beaver Dam, Kentucky, now living in Los Angeles.

videos.title: Tim Young: What World is This?
videos.overview: Tim headlines clubs all over North America, has performed on over 500 college campuses as well as comedy festivals in New York, Montreal, and Seattle, and he's a fixture in the New York City club scene.

videos.title: Collin Moulton: Anti-Animal Vegan
videos.overview: Collin is one of the most fun, personable, and sought after headliners today. He has had his own stand-up special on Showtime, he's been on Nickelodeon, and was recently featured on Last Call with Carson Daly.

videos.title: Josh Fonokalafi: The Specific Islander
videos.overview: Joshua Fonokalafi is a Utah-based comedian from the mean streets of Ogden, Utah's own Compton. Raised in the Northwest and the son of an Islander immigrant, Joshua tells of his hardships growing up as one of the biggest minorities in the country.

videos.title: Andrew Sleighter: Breakfast Stealer
videos.overview: Andrew Sleighter started in comedy looking for the perfect funny line to open a biography. Since then, Andrew's laid-back style and clever writing has won him appreciation from fans and respect from his peers.

videos.title: Key Lewis: Half Black, Half White, Looks Mexican
videos.overview: Sacramento, California-born Key Lewis is a high energy, improvisational, storytelling, multiple-personality nutcase!

videos.title: Leland Klassen: More True
videos.overview: Raised on a farm in the heart of Canada, Leland quickly learned that shoveling manure and weeding potatoes, although lucrative, wasn't his passion in life.

videos.title: Keith Stubbs: Poundcake
videos.overview: Keith Stubbs is a 'triple threat' in showbiz and entertainment. He's a hilarious stand-up comedian, talented actor, and award-winning radio personality. Keith was twice-voted 'Best Comedian' by City Weekly, the Standard-Examiner named him 'Funniest Comic' and he was a semi-finalist in Comedy Central's Laugh Riots comedy competition.

videos.title: Paul Sheffield: Singled Out
videos.overview: Paul has been doing comedy since 2008 and has been headlining in Utah, Idaho, and Wyoming. He has a CD on iTunes - "Sheffield Had it Worse." He is the winner of the 2010 Happy Valley Comedy Competition.

videos.title: Jordan Makin: The BFFG (The Big Fat Funny Ginger)
videos.overview: Born and raised in the heart of Utah County, Jordan Makin had to compensate for his red hair and uneventful childhood by learning to be funny.

videos.title: Dave Burleigh: Nobody's Keeping you Here
videos.overview: Comedian and Impressionist Dave Burleigh's star is on the rise. His uncanny ability to impersonate just about anyone landed him the starring role as Charlie Sheen in "Not Another Celebrity Movie." Burleigh's multiple characters, voices, and impressions were showcased on Season 7 of America's Got Talent, where he became a fast favorite of both judges and fans alike.

videos.title: Aaron Woodall: Unknown
videos.overview: Adored by girlfriends' mothers everywhere, Aaron Woodall is a nice, young man coming to grips with a dirty, cynical world.

videos.title: Patrick Keane: Long Love the Keane
videos.overview: Originally from the Midwest, raised in Orange County, college in Montana and a three-year stint in Asia make Patrick Keane a comedian with a background.

videos.title: Brad Stine: Put a Helmet on... 2017!
videos.overview: Brad Stine's 1st major release and features Brad's wonderfully hilarious brand of clean comedy. Brad's comedy is sweeping the nation and his popularity is booming! He is the most media-covered Christian comedian in the country. He had an 8-page profile written about him and his comedy in the New Yorker magazine where he was referred to as Gods Comic.

videos.title: Cash Levy: Game of Chance
videos.overview: If you missed Cash on Fox Sports or haven’t bought his newly released comedy CD, Extemporaneous, you’re probably familiar with seeing his act on Comedy Central, Fox Sports, NBC, The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson (CBS), Comics Unleashed, Just For Laughs Toronto, Moontowers Comedy Festival, Comedy.TV.

videos.title: Jason Love: Jokes on Me
videos.overview: One of today's busiest comics, Jason Love has appeared on HBO, Comedy Central, America's Got Talent, and over 20 national broadcasts.Jason works clean and incorporates music, making him a favorite for companies like Google, Chevron, Farmers, and Costco.

videos.title: Jason Hewlett: I'm the Weird One
videos.overview: The Award-Winning One-Man Show of Jason Hewlett The Entertainer will have you laughing until it hurts. Comedy, Music, Impressions, and Standing Ovations make Jason the perfect entertainer.

videos.title: Zoltan Kaszas: Cat Jokes
videos.overview: Zoltan Kaszas was born in Budapest, Hungary and raised in San Diego, California. He first stepped onstage at the age of nineteen and he was hooked immediately.

videos.title: Moody McCarthy: The Good Jew
videos.overview: Moody was born "Matthew" in Syracuse, NY, into a rambunctious household with six siblings. (They're Irish...somebody had to get a nickname.) He began doing comedy in 1992 and was soon hired by Syracuse's top morning radio show to cover sports and write jokes, his first loves.

videos.title: Kevin Bozeman: Clean and Unfiltered
videos.overview: In 1999, Kevin found himself in the real world with no real job skills and a strong desire to work an hour a day.

videos.title: Johnny Beehner: The Flamingo Special
videos.overview: Johnny Beehner puts on a funny show. He's got everything you want from a comic: He's silly, he's likeable, and he's fun.

videos.title: Paul Morrissey: A Real Humdinger
videos.overview: Paul was raised as a sports fanatic in the tiny town of Owego, in upstate New York. After four years of playing college basketball, somehow he graduated.

videos.title: Steve Mazan: Humblebragger
videos.overview: Steve Mazan shot out of the famous San Francisco scene that produced comedy legends such as Robin Williams and Dana Carvey.

videos.title: Chris Voth: Cashmere
videos.overview: Chris Voth is an accomplished comedian, a licensed teacher, and a published author. Voth made his debut late-night television appearance on the Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson.

videos.title: Keith Barany: Dude... Seriously?
videos.overview: There's no doubt Keith Barany delivers the laughs, every single time he hits the stage. As a tested and veteran touring pro, Keith could explain for hours about the subtle skill set he employs to make the laughs happen.

videos.title: Scott Novotny: A Trip to Goofyville
videos.overview: Scott Novotny brings his high-energy goofyness to the live audience at DryBar.

videos.title: Sam Adams: Incoherently True
videos.overview: Smooth. Clever. Hilarious. These words are often used to describe Sam Adams as a comedian, public speaker and Master of Ceremonies.

videos.title: Lucas Bohn: 2 Cool 4 School
videos.overview: LUCAS BOHN is energetic with an edge. The perfect blend of schoolboy charm and bad-boy charisma, his comedy is both smart and audacious.

videos.title: Warren B. Hall: Mostly Kid Stuff
videos.overview: Simply put; Warren B Hall is not what you're expecting. He purposely avoids using the white vs black angle done by many mainstream black comedians.

videos.title: Sean Peabody: Peabody in Provo
videos.overview: He is often mistaken for the bouncer, security guard or bachelorette party stripper but rarely a comedian…until he takes the stage.

videos.title: Dwayne Perkins: Please Believe It
videos.overview: Dwayne Perkins has earned a spot in today's elite class of stand-up comics with appearances on Comedy Central and on Conan.

videos.title: Scott Losse: Okay
videos.overview: Scott Losse is a stand-up comedian from Seattle, Washington. He is married and has two chihuahuas. Scott has performed at Portland's Bridgetown Comedy Festival, SF Sketchfest, Sketchfest Seattle, Bumbershoot: Seattle's Music & Arts Festival, Treefort Music Fest and lots of places that aren't festivals.

videos.title: Frances Dilorenzo: The Problem Solver
videos.overview: Frances takes the stage full of energy and ready for fun. Frances does one thing you don't see many female comics do…physical humor, and she delivers it with every silly bone in her body.

videos.title: Drew Barth: Shoulda Tried Harder
videos.overview: Drew Barth is one of the fastest rising comedy stars in the Northwest. Born just outside the city of Seattle, what started as a dare in high school has become a full-time career.

videos.title: Dennis Regan: DennisLand
videos.overview: The King Of Queens writer Dennis Regan comes swinging hard with his quick wit and flawless delivery. The laughs just keep on coming in "Dennisland".

videos.title: Andy Hendrickson: Left Field
videos.overview: Andy Hendrickson has multiple TV appearances including: The Late Show with David Letterman, The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson, Gotham Comedy Live, NBC/Seeso's The Guest List and more.

videos.title: Steve Bruner: Simply Put
videos.overview: Steve Bruner looks like a perfectly normal guy—until he opens his mouth. He's delivered his laser-sharp humor on Comedy Club Network (Showtime), An Evening at the Improv (A&E), Into the Night (ABC), and The Byron Allen Show (NBC), to name a few.

videos.title: Jessi Campbell: Sharpest Knife on the Porch
videos.overview: Jessi Campbell has recently been seen on Last Comic Standing. She was the 2015 Campus Activities Magazine Female Performer of the Year, an award she was also nominated for in 2013.

videos.title: Tyler Boeh: Wait for It
videos.overview: Who goes from being a mild-mannered nationally recognized college a-capella group vocal percussionist to becoming a high-energy, intelligent, physical, and downright silly beatboxing comedian?

videos.title: Shayne Smith: Prison for Wizards
videos.overview: Former Gang Member, current comedian, future famous comedian. Shayne Smith is the runner up in the Wiseguys' 2015 Funniest Person In Utah competition, winner of the 2015 Salt City Comedy Superstar contest and most recently voted best Alternative Comedian of 2016 by City Weekly.

videos.title: Rex Havens: Women and Children First
videos.overview: Rex has been delighting comedy audiences for 20 years, in world-famous comedy clubs like The Improv, Catch-A-Rising Star, Funny Bones and Zanies, on television for Showtime, Comedy Central and Comic Relief, on radio with Bob & Tom and NPR, cruise ships worldwide, and corporate clients including GM, American Express, Texaco, 3M, Coca-Cola, IBM, Toshiba, Lowe's, Johnson & Johnson, Ameritech, Proctor & Gamble, State Farm, Quaker Oats, Verizon and the IRS ("Working for the IRS is the only sure way to get money from them."), and numerous non-profit and charitable organizations, such as St.

videos.title: Tony Deyo: Sleep When the Baby Sleeps
videos.overview: Tony Deyo is a stand-up comedian known most notably for his sharp, quick material and near-perfect comedic timing almost certainly gained from his years as a professional symphony musician.

videos.title: Andrew Rivers: Laffy Taffy
videos.overview: Andrew's very personal and fun storytelling comedy, combined with his exemplary work ethic has earned him high praise from some of the best comedians in the business.

videos.title: Arvin Mitchell: Circus Purpose
videos.overview: With an array of impressions, stories, gestures and faces, Arvin's memorable performance is sure to please. As the former co-host of BET's Club Comic View, Arvin has been featured on Kevin Heart's "One Mic Stand", Tony Rocks "The Funny Spot", as well as entertaining our troops abroad.

videos.title: Tim Slagle: Team Mammal
videos.overview: Utterly old and running a lengthy budget deficit, Tim Slagle blames reptiles, the Gallery of Frigid Air, happy endings, and Nigerian royalty.

videos.title: Al Goodwin: Badgerine
videos.overview: Big Al connects with his audiences--getting them to appreciate the lighter side of their own lives relating his observations and experiences.

videos.title: Jay Whittaker: Safe for Work
videos.overview: Jay Whittaker is a comedian, actor, host and writer hailing from Los Angeles & Salt Lake City. He's been seen on the Food Network and even featured in USA Today.

videos.title: Tom Ryan: Off the Verge
videos.overview: Over the years Tom Ryan has worked steadily at comedy clubs, concert venues, corporate functions and colleges across the U.S.. He has also made national television appearances on Showtime, A&E Comedy Central, and… Three times on "The Late Show with David Letterman!".

videos.title: Matt Knudsen: Good News
videos.overview: Matt Knudsen was born in Hawaii, raised in the Mid-west and sailed around the world as a merchant marine. As an actor, Matt shared the big screen with Oscar winner Sean Penn in Gangster Squad, or you may also recognize him from his appearances in shows like Crazy Ex-Girlfriend, Key & Peele, Workaholics, The League, Big Love, Boston Legal or Malcolm in the Middle just to name a few.

videos.title: Kjell Bjorgen: I'm Sorry, But I Won't Apologize
videos.overview: Kjell began his comedy career in Los Angeles, California. He gained some notoriety when featured in both the Chicago comedy festival and Montreal comedy festival.

videos.title: Tom Mabe: Dysfunction Junction
videos.overview: Tom has been profiled in People magazine, called "gut-busting hilarious" by The New York Times, and given a perfect 4-star rating by the New York Post.

videos.title: Mike Toomey: Welcome to My World
videos.overview: With his Sharp Delivery, quick wit, and unique style, Mike Toomey has been a favorite at comedy clubs and special events since 1982.

videos.title: Andy Peters: Bargain Basement
videos.overview: Andy Peters will get you. Where you sit, stand or hide. Wherever. Peters is a stand- up comedian who enjoys getting to the audience like no other.

videos.title: Cory Michaelis: Bad Teacher
videos.overview: A teacher by day and comic by night, Cory Michaelis keeps his act edgy enough to keep the audience from feeling like they’re in his 10th grade History class. He cleverly tells short stories and jokes that try to get audiences to think but are silly and absurd as well. Cory is a regular in all of the clubs in the Pacific Northwest and has headlined clubs, colleges, casinos, and weird bars all over the country. He didn't win the 2013 World Series of Comedy (semi-finals), and the 2012 Seattle international Comedy Competition (SICC), or the 2014 Tacoma Comdy Content (2nd) but he took another crack at the SICC and made the 2014 finals.

videos.title: Andy Woodhull: World's Greatest Step-Dad
videos.overview: Andy recently appeared on Conan on TBS. Around that same time, his half-hour special premiered on Comedy Central.

videos.title: Alex Velluto: Thirsty
videos.overview: Alex Velluto is a stand-up comedian and Diet Coke drinker from Salt Lake City, Utah. He has performed at comedy festivals all over the country including the Boston Comedy Festival, Big Sky Comedy Festival, and the Seattle International Comedy Competition.

videos.title: Tommy Ryman: Activated
videos.overview: Tommy Ryman grew up with a new-age, folk singing mother and a traditional, Lutheran insurance-agent father. This XY equation evidently equals: acclaimed comedian.

videos.title: Leanne Morgan: So Yummy
videos.overview: Leanne Morgan exudes southern charm. She is a naturally funny storyteller who gives an honest look at suburban life and the challenges of keeping her husband happy while juggling kids, dogs and cheerleading camp at the same time she's racing to get her hair highlighted, have a colonoscopy and join weight watchers for the 7th time!

videos.title: Josh Sneed: Live in the Dessert
videos.overview: Hailing from the great city of Cincinnati, Ohio, Josh comes to Dry Bar to bring "new life" to his comedy. Being funny 24/7 can be difficult, but Josh Sneed does it.

videos.title: Corey Rodrigues: People Whisperer
videos.overview: Corey is a highly sought after national touring college, club and corporate and cruise ship performer. He was the winner of The Catch a New Rising Star, The Funniest Comic in New England and the 2017 Big Sky Comedy Festivals.

videos.title: B.T: My Life As I Know it Now
videos.overview: With an act that crosses all boundaries, B.T. will surely have you rolling with laughter. His physical performance style and charm landed him two performances on NBC's Friday Night Videos and a performance at the prestigious HBO U.S.

videos.title: Andrew Hobbs: A Joke Unless It Works
videos.overview: Have you ever, as an adult, been bullied by a healthcare professional or popular middle school girl? Andrew has.

videos.title: Greg Morton: I Started Out, As a Baby
videos.overview: Greg Morton had only two choices in schoolyard conflicts. Learn the ways of the force, or use his wit to diffuse situations.

videos.title: Spencer James: Bullies Are Necessary
videos.overview: Spencer has performed all over North America, he has won festivals, and he was recently featured on Fox's television show "Laughs." Yet now, with the title as a Las Vegas headliner, he brings all of his talents to the stage for a once in a generation experience.

videos.title: Mark Christopher Lawrence: Clean Outta Compton
videos.overview: Mark Christopher Lawrence (born May 22, 1964) is an American character actor, stand-up comedian, and voice-over artist.

videos.title: Mike Paramore: You've Just Been Flirted With
videos.overview: Mike Paramore is the guy you fight to sit next to in a movie theatre, on a long car ride, or during a boring lecture.

videos.title: Costaki Economopoulos: Now That I'm A Grown Up
videos.overview: For 20 years, Costaki has been living his dream as a full-time stand up comic. He has written jokes for Bette Midler, Jay Leno, MTV, and BET.

videos.title: Mike Speenberg: Uphill Both Ways
videos.overview: Mike Speenberg has been a professional touring Stand-up comedian for 20 years. He's performed on 5 different continents, entertained everyone from Hall of Fame Athletes to US Diplomats, shared the stage with everyone from Robin Williams to Bill Burr, and been featured on everything from CNN to the AMERICAN FORCES RADIO NETWORK.

videos.title: Eric O'Shea: Life: It's Not Your Fault!
videos.overview: Eric O'Shea has been active in the comedy business for 25 years. He has performed in L.A. with Betty White at the Creative Emmy Awards and has appeared on America's Got Talent.

videos.title: Greg Warren: Fish Sandwich
videos.overview: Greg Warren is a nationally touring headliner and has been featured on Late Night with Seth Meyers, Last Comic Standing, Comedy Central Presents, The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson, BET and CMT.

videos.title: John Wesley Austin: Straight Shooter
videos.overview: John Wesley Austin has been working the comedy club circuit for over 18 years, & it shows in his side-splitting and sometimes-outrageous stand-up comedy.

videos.title: Fred Klett: One of Ten
videos.overview: Fred Klett has built a career from being a clean comedian, a style that is his trademark. His comedy is G-rated and focused to appeal to families with members of all ages since much of his material is taken from his experiences growing up in a large Christian family.

videos.title: Jeff Jena: Old Dog, New Jokes
videos.overview: Jeffrey Jena is one of the top corporate and cruise comics working today. His thirty-three years of live performance experience and over forty national television shows, both as an actor and comic give him the ability to work for any audience

videos.title: Anyway... Here's Adam Cozens
videos.overview: A hilarious performer, Adam has been seen on IFC's "The Birthday Boys," HBO's "Got No Game," and TBS's "Lopez Tonight." His stand up has been featured on Nickelodeon's "NickMom," Hulu's "West Coast Funnies" "Tell Your Friends: The Concert Film," "The CoExist Comedy Tour" documentary, "ComedyTime," as well as heard worldwide on Sirius|XM Radio.

videos.title: Kendra Cunningham: On My Best Behavior
videos.overview: Boston bred and Brooklyn based, Kendra Cunningham has been named as a comic to watch by Time Out New York and has been compared to Groucho Marx and Mae West by the UK's Chortle.

videos.title: Lamuweri Guluka: The First Option
videos.overview: Lamuweri Guluka is an African name meaning "hard to pronounce on the first try." Lam is a seasoned comedian who has performed at colleges, comedy clubs, and cafes all over the country whose background as a nerdy, suburban, black male gives him a unique comedic perspective that audiences love.

videos.title: Mike P. Burton: I Can Get Whiter
Karen Mills: Pink Pants
videos.overview: Karen Mills has made a career out of making people laugh. She's been a nationally touring comedian for 25 years and can be heard daily on Sirius / XM comedy channels.

videos.title: Danny Villalpando: Too Informative
videos.overview: Danny has been performing stand up comedy for over sixteen years. He's had the opportunity to work for many corporate events, charity organizations, and cruise ships.

videos.title: Mike Guido: Sanity Optional
videos.overview: Mike Guido has made his mark as a nationally known headlining comedian. He has made eight national TV appearances including SHOWTIME, A&E, MTV, and VH1 and has worked with some of today's biggest stars such as Jay Leno, Robin Williams, and Ellen Degenneres.

videos.title: Jimmy Della Valle: Famous Nobody
videos.overview: Jimmy is well known for his high energy rapid-fire delivery, hilarious stories, and one-liners as well as amazing improvisation off the audience responses with Headlining performances that are always on the edge with his unique edgy streetwise point of view.

videos.title: Seth Tippetts: Tall. Dark. Gigante.
videos.overview: Get to know Seth from the chest down. He's big, he's tall, but most of all he's hilarious. Check out this Utah-raised, clean, and semi-professional comedian today!

videos.title: Kim Kerley: Do You Know Her?
videos.overview: Having spent much of her teens homeless, Kim Kerley has seen things in life that many never see. She's chosen to find the funny in those situations.

videos.title: Tim Wilkins: Password Protected
videos.overview: Today that dream is more alive than ever as he is a 20-year veteran stand-up comedian, TV and radio personality, speaker and writer, who has performed on stages around the world.

videos.title: Tom Foss: Walking Shoes
videos.overview: Tom Foss has traveled around the world entertaining our troops. Including 5 tours to Iraq, 6 tours of Afghanistan, 11 tours of the middle east, 4 tours of Europe, 3 tours of the Far East, Greenland, 5 aircraft carriers, support ships and bases all around the United States.

videos.title: Jim McCue: Nothing Personal
videos.overview: With his unique act, Jim keeps the audience on its toes. Volleying between set material and working the crowd, Jim cracks jokes with amazing timing and whip-like precision.

videos.title: Mark Poolos: One Wife, Two Daughters, Zero Influence
videos.overview: Mark stands 6'7" weighs in at 350, technically a giant, however he is very weak and a wimp. In his routines, he weaves the story of his life as a bumbling jolly giant in his fast engaging storytelling style.

videos.title: Rahn Hortman: Good Game
videos.overview: Witty and relatable, Rahn Hortman’s comedy is centered around finding humor in his own experiences. In his Dry Bar Comedy special, Hortman riffs on children who are politely disrespectful, economy hotels, women referring to him as cute instead of handsome, and taking his wife’s birth control on accident.

videos.title: Kortney Shane Williams: Unsubstantiated
videos.overview: The master of satire has been a part of The Bridgetown Comedy Festival, Boston Comedy Festival, Laughing Skull Comedy Festival, and Bumbershoot Arts festival.

videos.title: Andy Gold: Dreamcatcher
videos.overview: Andy Gold has appeared in festivals and competitions all over the country, including the Boston Comedy Festival, San Diego Comedy Festival, Laugh Your Asheville Off and Comcast's Trial by Laughter Comedy Festival.

videos.title: Cleto Rodriguez: Cleto is My Real Name
videos.overview: Rodriguez connects with audiences by relating everyday life experiences. Anything and everything is fair game, from marriage mishaps to the challenges of dieting.

videos.title: Jeff "Big Daddy" Wayne - Big Daddy Kicks It!
videos.overview: Comedian Jeff Wayne was dubbed "Big Daddy" by Billy Crystal and Robin Williams on an HBO Comic Relief show. The moniker has stuck to a guy who's been part of the stand-up comedy scene for a long time.

videos.title: Jeff Allen: I Can Laugh About It Now
videos.overview: Jeff Allen combines clean, hilarious humor like no other comedian working today. Besides performing at corporate functions and fundraisers, he regularly appears on television, radio, and casinos across the country.

videos.title: Daren Streblow: Organic and Inorganic Life
videos.overview: Daren Streblow's unique style of observational stand-up comedy has been entertaining hundreds-of-thousands of people throughout the United States and around the world since he first stepped on the stage in 1995.

videos.title: Kevin Jordan: Cause I Said So!
videos.overview: A Former Los Angeles Police Officer, Kevin has thrilled audiences at Clubs, on Cruise ships, and for the troops worldwide.

videos.title: Andy Beningo: Adorable Tough Guy
videos.overview: Over the past decade, Andy Beningo has established himself as one of the hardest working comedians in the business.

videos.title: Danny Johnson: The Chusky Life
videos.overview: Danny Johnson's hilarious, clean stand-up has entertained audiences in comedy clubs, corporate events, and churches nationwide.

videos.title: Marc Yaffee: Mid-Laugh Crisis
videos.overview: Adopted at birth and confused ever since, Marc takes his audiences on a comedy joyride as he explores his multi-ethnic roots and the culture clashes that fill his world.

videos.title: Ty Barnett: Yep...
videos.overview: Ty Barnett, a Chicago native, got his start at Seattle's Comedy Underground. Whoopi Goldberg called Ty "hilarious" and reviewers have said he is "thought provoking" and "edgy".

videos.title: Byron Trimble: Diary of a Short City Boy
videos.overview: Byron Trimble has traveled around the world doing comedy for conferences, churches, retreats, clubs, schools, and corporate events.

videos.title: Erica Rhodes: I Love You More
videos.overview: Erica Rhodes is a regular panelist on Comedy Central's @midnight and Fox's Punchline. She has made appearances on SeeSo's The Guest List, Hulu's Coming to the Stage, AXS' Live at Gotham and the syndicated Comics Unleashed.

videos.title: Jamie Lissow: Something Awesome
videos.overview: Actor and comedian Jamie Lissow is best known for his role in the current Netflix Original Series Real Rob, alongside SNL alum Rob Schneider, a show Jamie co-wrote and co-produced.

videos.title: Chad Thornsberry: Junk-Cars and Valet Parking
videos.overview: Chad Thornsberry was born in St. Louis, MO. From an early age he learned his family was blessed, and blessed him with humor, quick wit, and a love of storytelling.

videos.title: Mike Siegel: Have Jokes, Will Travel
videos.overview: Mike Siegel is a stand-up comedian, TV host, and actor. For nine years, he hosted TBS network's TBS Movie EXTRA and has hosted numerous other network shows including HGTV's If Walls Could Talk and What You Get For the Money, GSN Live on the Game Show Network, and The Next GAC Star on GAC.

videos.title: Rodney Laney: Who is Rodney Laney?
videos.overview: Rodney Laney has completed pilots for Comedy Central, MTV, and A&E. He has been seen on HBO, FOX News Channel's Red Eye, The Late Late Show on CBS, Comedy Central's Premium Blend, comedy.tv on the HD channel, two appearances on Gotham Comedy Live AXSTV, and Live in Gotham VR.

videos.title: Will Marfori: Eat Your Vegetables
videos.overview: Will Marfori has appeared on the Late, Late Show with Craig Ferguson and is a regular on Sirius/XM Satellite radio.

videos.title: Joe Devito: First of All...
videos.overview: Joe DeVito's dead-on timing and unexpected twists make him a favorite at comedy clubs across the USA. His TV appearances include The Late Late Show, Last Comic Standing, Comedy Central, Comics Unleashed, and AXStv's Gotham Comedy Live.

videos.title: Orlando Baxter: Glorified Baby Sitter
videos.overview: Orlando Baxter exploded onto the Boston comedy scene in 2005, and quickly established himself as one of the areas hottest young comics.

videos.title: Taylor Mason: Hysterical Perspective
videos.overview: TAYLOR MASON cannot be defined in a word or a sentence or even a video. His singular career has taken him from Carnegie Hall to The Sydney Opera House, to countless television appearances and a million online "hits." TAYLOR has blazed his own trail of unique entertainment, resulting in a schedule jam-packed with performances in every venue for every audience, and is one of a very few who can succeed in comedy clubs, churches, theaters, cruise ships, and for corporate clients that range from Fortune 500 companies to small businesses.

videos.title: Daniel Eachus: A Mild and Skinny Guy
videos.overview: Daniel Eachus talks about weird jobs, strange fears, and how to prank restaurants all through the lens of being the lifelong skinny guy.

videos.title: Mike Brody: Not Afraid of Butterflies
videos.overview: Starting comedy on a whim at an open mic in the year 2000, Mike Brody has since devoted his life to perfecting the delivery of his high-energy act.

videos.title: James Johann: Rurally Funny
videos.overview: James Johann was born in the Midwest during the 70s era of bell-bottom jeans, wood-paneled station wagons and disco music.

videos.title: Kristin Key: Crafty
videos.overview: Kristin Key grew up a minister's daughter in a small town in West Texas. Much like Footloose, she was raised in a no-drinking, no-dancing, no instrumental music environment.

videos.title: David Dyer: Further Along Than Anyone Expected
videos.overview: David Dyer has been performing at stand-up at comedy clubs and corporate events for over twenty years. He's worked with some of the best comics in the industry including Mike Birbiglia, Jim Breuer, and Lewis Black.

videos.title: Don Barnhart: The Spinal Disintergration of Man
videos.overview: Barnhart's stand up comedy show is a thrill ride of well-written, topical material exploring modern day society in a way that is hysterical, intelligent and thought-provoking.

videos.title: Vinnie Montez: Armed & Hilarious
videos.overview: Vinnie Montez is a loud, boisterous, and insightful comic. A Colorado native, he grew up in the largely homogenous community of Boulder, which prides itself on being a bastion of cultural diversity, but which is honestly just weird.

videos.title: Rik Roberts: Put Down the Sweet Tea
videos.overview: Rik Roberts brings a little bit of Nashville everywhere he goes. From quick bits about family and technology, to surprising stories about marriage and music – you'll find something you can relate to.

videos.title: Brandon Vestal: Who?
videos.overview: Brandon Vestal's low key, deeply personal and honest style has made him a fast favorite in the comedy world, a "Don't Miss" for college audiences, and a club favorite.

videos.title: Buddy Fitzpatrick: Still in the Driveway
videos.overview: BUDDY FITZPATRICK, a native of Philadelphia, is currently a New York City club favorite sharing his comedy perspective.

videos.title: Bengt Washburn: Not Bad
videos.overview: Bengt Washburn is an Aquarius with Hazel eyes who prefers boxer briefs, solid deodorants, and Crest toothpaste.

videos.title: Larry Omaha: Freaky Times in a Freaky World
videos.overview: Omaha's insightful view on multi-ethnic America has garnered him numerous tv appearances and places him in great demand.

videos.title: Bob Smiley: Tartar Terrorist
videos.overview: In-demand stand up comedian known for his machine gun approach and hilarious, clean material. He has performed all over the U.S.

videos.title: Lee Hardin: Not Quite A Grown Up
videos.overview: Lee Hardin is a comedian known for making bad decisions and his love for Taco Bell.

videos.title: Matt Falk: Un-Lit
videos.overview: Matt Falk was called "effortlessly funny" by the CBC. He's performed at Just For Laughs, The Hal!fax Comedy Festival and the Winnipeg Comedy Festival.

videos.title: Jeff Shaw: Manly Girly Man
videos.overview: Jeff Shaw's writing is marked both by idealism and humanity. His stimulating satire is often infused with poetic beauty.

videos.title: Andy Forrester: Most Of This Is Baby Fat
videos.overview: Andy Forrester's brand of off-the-wall humor has made him a fan favorite at clubs all over the country for almost 20 years.

videos.title: Ross Bennett: Comedy! ... For The Rest of Us
videos.overview: A popular headliner at comedy clubs worldwide, veteran comedian (and btw, he's also a veteran!), Ross Bennett has appeared on The Late Show with David Letterman, and, along with countless other TV appearances, was the winner of the Best Supporting Actor in A Comedy Web Series at the LAWEBFEST2016.

videos.title: Reno Collier: Monkey's and Stuff
videos.overview: Reno's journey began at the Punchline Comedy Club in Atlanta, GA where he tended bar to supplement his day job.

videos.title: Nazareth: American By Choice
videos.overview: Award Winning Comedian Nazareth, has been seen by over 40 Million people around the world through live concerts, TV and Radio broadcasts.

videos.title: Moody Molavi: Remove Before Flight
videos.overview: The Christian comic is married to his high school sweetheart, who later became his stepsister through the marriage of their parents to each other.

videos.title: Joe Zimmerman: Captain Snuggle Pants
videos.overview: Joe Zimmerman grew up in Morgantown, West Virginia, and started his comedy career in North Carolina. While living in the South, his stand-up group the Beards of Comedy landed a record deal with Comedy Central Records.

videos.title: Doug Thompson: Who Taught You That?
videos.overview: With a different look on the everyday life, and the ability to find positive funny analogies on the pitfalls of it all; comedian Doug Thompson is a ray of light.

videos.title: Jay Stevens: Life is Hilarious
videos.overview: Jay Stevens has been a professional comedian for almost 20 years. Growing up, he was known as a hilarious outgoing character by friends, family, colleagues and those he would meet on a first encounter.

videos.title: Robert Mac: Back to Lake Titicaca
videos.overview: Robert Mac returns to the Dry Bar stage with less smartness, less subtleness, and even more silliness.

videos.title: Lisa Mills: This Is My Real Accent
videos.overview: Lisa Mills is an Atlanta based, award-winning comedian, speaker, and author. Her acting debut was working alongside network television's favorite military gal, Catherine Bell on the Lifetime Channel's hit show, Army Wives.

videos.title: Dave Nihill: Documented
videos.overview: From Dublin, Ireland, Dave Nihill is the winner of the prestigious San Francisco Comedy Competition, runner up in the Moth's largest US Grandslam storytelling competition and a best-selling writer.

videos.title: Ron Ruhman: Weird Stuff
videos.overview: Ron has been called a "High Energy Seinfeld". He brings a very energetic style to the stage as he shares his interesting slant on day-to-day life in an act that is clean, smart, and very entertaining.

videos.title: Tommy Drake: Mouse
videos.overview: Since the early 90s Tommy Drake has been a staple in the stand-up comedy world. Tommy's unique mixture of original material delivered in a classic style has given him the opportunity to do more shows and be seen by more people live than just about any other comic on the planet.

videos.title: DC Benny: You Don't Look Funny
videos.overview: Benny lives in Brooklyn where he fiddles around with old Land Rovers when he is supposed to be helping his wife run her natural skincare business.

videos.title: Andy Erikson: Unicorn Style
videos.overview: Andy Erikson's love of cats and unicorns is only surpassed by her love of performing stand-up comedy. In 2015, Andy placed in the top five on NBC's Last Comic Standing and in 2016 she played Marguerite Honeywell on Ryan Murphy's television series Scream Queens on Fox.

videos.title: Josh Blue: The Disabled List
videos.overview: Josh Blue's second special arrives this Saturday, December 4th!Comedian, Paralympian, and musician, Josh Blue riffs on copper healing bracelets, American disgrace in the Paralympics, and his obligation to use disability access technology.

videos.title: Cam Bertrand: Sophisticated Ignorance
videos.overview: Cam shares his outlook on relationships and life through the eyes of a 23-year-old in a way that everyone can relate to.

videos.title: JJ Barrows: Doodle All Day
videos.overview: JJ Barrows was raised in South Carolina as the middle child of a preacher's family. Having always felt a little different, JJ uses humor to navigate through the realities of life, being single through her thirties, and adjusting to life changes brought about by age, a cross country move, and eventually….

videos.title: Joe Larson: Champion
videos.overview: Joe Larson, the son of a working comedian, started comedy at an early age and has always had a knack for making light of any situation.

videos.title: Richard Sarvate: Missed the Window
videos.overview: Richard Sarvate quit his ten year programming career in Silicon Valley to be a stand up comedian. Oops! Now he spends his nights poking fun at tech jobs, talking about his experience as a first generation Indian immigrant, and bringing silliness to anyone in earshot.

videos.title: Chris Cope: Baby Face
videos.overview: Chris Cope, a Florida transplant now living in Los Angeles. The city has been good to Chris in just 4 short years he's appeared on Jimmy Kimmel Live, Tosh.O, Laughs on Fox.

videos.title: Nick Guerra: Enjoy Life
videos.overview: Nick Guerra is loved by comedy audiences in clubs, corporate events, private parties, and colleges across the country, this guy tickles everyone's funny bone with his cool but energetic attitude, as he skewers relationships, family, and everyday life.

videos.title: Joey ILO: Just Work With What You Got
videos.overview: Making jokes and being wild and silly had been seen as a weakness for Joey growing up in Wisconsin, but now it's what makes him unique and relatable.

videos.title: Jason Russell: Beige Frosty
videos.overview: Like most comedians, finding a way to be silly in class was a way to get attention from classmates and teachers!

videos.title: Shayne Smith: Alligator Boys
videos.overview: Stand-up comedian Shayne Smith delivers more stories about everything from a failed robbery to a wrestling match in the New York Subway and even saving the life of a dog in his second original Dry Bar Comedy special, "Alligator Boys".

videos.title: Jeremy Nunes: Neighborhood Sasq-Watch
videos.overview: Jeremy Nunes has drawn rave reviews from critics for his clever observations, unique storytelling style, and ability to improvise with his audience.

videos.title: Karen Morgan: Go Dawgs!
videos.overview: In Karen Morgan’s experience, KonMari-ing doesn’t work on people; nut juice is not, and never will be, milk; and middle aged woman who walk together, save lives together.

videos.title: Ryan Erwin: Vertical Claps
videos.overview: Two words that describe Ryan are sassy and gassy. He works by day as a middle school theatre teacher. He was awarded the 2018 Teaching Star of the Year winner by the Utah Middle School Teachers Association.

videos.title: Ken Rogerson: Way North of 40
videos.overview: Ken Rogerson, the funniest man you've never heard of, started his comedy career working the Chicago club circuit and at the famed Second City.

videos.title: Dan St. Paul: Mocking the Suburbs
videos.overview: Dan St. Paul has been chronicling his life on stage for 30 years. After turning fifty, he discovered his body changing, "I'm a cylinder now."

videos.title: Chris Young: Buoyant Mon
videos.overview: Chris Young is able to take real-life experiences and turn them into laughs that maintain a clean but funny appearance.

videos.title: John Deming: Sadder Than Most Horses
videos.overview: One of the most exciting young comics in Utah, John Deming's shows are as unpredictable as they are side-splitting.

videos.title: Rob Brackenridge: Legend Dairy
videos.overview: Rob's lifelong global travels have given his comedy a unique style that appeals to a wide audience. From Las Vegas casino crowds to colleges across the country, his keen ear for accents and wacky characterizations keep 'em rolling in the aisles.

videos.title: Dylan Mandlsohn: Cruising America
videos.overview: Dylan Mandlsohn uses his own brilliant comedy to entertain and challenge social norms by pushing boundaries that promote forward thinking to his Stand-up audiences across this globe.

videos.title: Jeff Capri: Capricious
videos.overview: Jeff's ongoing comedy trek has enabled him to work alongside many respected entertainers, including Ellen DeGeneres, Rodney Dangerfield, Joy Behar, and Bill Burr.

videos.title: Shawn Reynolds: Got Room For One More?
videos.overview: Shawn Reynolds is a nationally touring, clean comedian and funny dad of six who's not afraid to tell people he's also a trophy husband.

videos.title: Jim Colliton: Please Take The Lunch
videos.overview: Jim Colliton addresses some housekeeping. If you have kids, get an industrial paper shredder. If you have a turtle with ADHD, don’t take it to the vet. If you have a dog, greet your wife first. And if you want an honest opinion, ask a two year old.

videos.title: Chris Strait: Laugh Till You Run Out of Air
videos.overview: If your type of comedian is someone who reminds us all how funny we all are, Chris Strait is for you! No funny topic is off-limits for this California native… but he's just telling his story.

videos.title: Steve Soelberg: Pirate Hymns
videos.overview: Steve Soelberg is back, living his best life with appendicitis, and singing pirate hymns to make it though this set of fresh new jokes for you.

videos.title: Maher Matta: Personally Speaking
videos.overview: Comedian Maher Matta has been performing standup comedy for nearly sixteen years. He has appeared on FOX's "Laughs TV", has performed at comedy clubs across the country, hired for private events, and placed in comedy festivals and competitions.

videos.title: Maija DiGiorgio: Maija Pinion
videos.overview: In her comedy, Maija examines the complexities of what it means to be a mixed-race, multicultural woman through the context of trivial topics like dating, family, and daily observations.

videos.title: Ricky Glore: Dad Bod
videos.overview: Ricky Glore is a stand up comedian and comedy writer known for his high energy and confidence on stage. He has opened for some of the top comedians, including Tracy Morgan, Damon Wayans, and Doug Benson.

videos.title: Matt Bergman: A Little Bit Balder Now
videos.overview: Matt Bergman has been honing his comedy craft since he was in college pursuing a degree in criminal justice. After graduating, he realized he was afraid of criminals and decided stand-up comedy was the way to go.

videos.title: Steve Geyer: Twice as Old as I Used to Be
videos.overview: Beginning as a nightclub comic, Steve Geyer found faith traveling the circuit and then recognized the opportunity to make people laugh with clean comedy.

videos.title: Josh Novey: Tickling Grizzlies
videos.overview: An Iraq War veteran, Josh has used his humor and easy-going stage presence to entertain thousands of people. Josh is a clean comedian, so every time he goes on stage you know the whole family will be able to enjoy.

videos.title: Bob Stromberg: I'm a Pretty Big Deal
videos.overview: Bob Stromberg is a funny man. For over forty years he's traveled the world performing his very unique and perfect blend of standup, story, and shtick.

videos.title: Chelle T: It Just Got Real
videos.overview: Laughing is great medication and now the doctor is in. Chelle T has hit the scene and has brought with her a whirlwind of imagination, stage presence, and originality.

videos.title: K-Von: Designer Muscles
videos.overview: K-von is the most famous Half-Persian comedian in the world. Raised by a religious family in Las Vegas; he's an expert at removing a bad word from a joke while keeping it funny.

videos.title: Kevin Downey Jr: (Seriously), Please Pray For Me
videos.overview: New York City comedian Kevin Downey, Jr. was a finalist on America's Got Talent. He is a regular in Las Vegas, and has the pleasure of entertaining our troops around the world.

videos.title: Marty Simpson: I Am Coach
videos.overview: Marty's act is filled with actual events from his life. Everything he says is a true story based on something that either happened to him, his kids, or that he made up entirely.

videos.title: Robert G. Lee: Laughter's Still Legal!
videos.overview: Robert has combined his Christian world view with his Monty Python sensibility and written many Veggie Tales videos such as "Little Joe," "Gideon" and "Sheerluck Holmes."

videos.title: John Branyan: Demeaning of Life
videos.overview: In November of 1990, John took the stage at an Indianapolis comedy club with the intention of getting comedy out of his system.

videos.title: Jesse Egan: That's the Spirit
videos.overview: Jesse performs stand-up comedy all over the country and has opened for Chris D'Elia, Theo Von, Dane Cook, Doug Stanhope, Joey Diaz, Brian Posehn and many more.

videos.title: Max Dolcelli: Funny is All Around Us
videos.overview: Max Dolcelli has appeared just about everywhere and done just about everything a comedian can do, performing in comedy clubs and comedy festivals in the U.S.

videos.title: Brad Trackman: Thanks
videos.overview: Brad Trackman is a national touring comedian who has been featured as a stand up on CBS's The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson, Comics Unleashed with Byron Allen, Star Search with Arsenio Hall, AXS tv's Gotham Comedy Live, MTV's The Buried Life, New Joke City with Robert Klein, NBC's Later, NBC's Friday Night and numerous appearances on Comedy Central.

videos.title: Bob Zany: I Think I Handled That Well
videos.overview: "He simply reaches into a bottomless grab bag of jokes, so smooth and effortless that it would be easy to overlook just how much talent and skill is behind the process'" -L.A. TImes

videos.title: Tom Simmons: Peace, Love and Whatnot
videos.overview: Tom Simmons talks about living and raising his son with love and non-violence (and how he's losing his mind in the process)

videos.title: Kabir Singh: Retiring Material
videos.overview: Kabir Singh is a huge crowd-pleaser with an abundance of energy, an in-your-face attitude, and clever material.

videos.title: Myles Weber: Pug Life
videos.overview: Opening his set by describing himself as a series of white dudes, Myles Weber hones in on the humor of his life experiences in his special, joking about growing up in the hood, playing The Green Lantern in an amusement park, and his three-legged pug Taz.

videos.title: LeClerc Andre: With All Due Respect
videos.overview: LeClerc Andre is having a breakout year as a featured New Face at the prestigious Just for Laughs Comedy Festival.

videos.title: Dave Dugan: Human Cannon-Ball
videos.overview: A one-of-a-kind delivery accompanied by impeccable timing and imaginative comedy angles has led DAVE DUGAN down the path to NATIONAL TV APPEARANCES and to RAVE REVIEWS from corporate event planners.

videos.title: Mike Goodwin: WhatchaNotGoneDo Is Not Laugh At These Jokes!
videos.overview: A southern gentleman with a curious mind, love for people, and heart for God, Mike Goodwin is in a class all his own.

videos.title: Caleb Elliott: Diary of a Smooth Black Kid
videos.overview: One of DryBar's youngest comics, Caleb Elliot proves that age is anything but a setback.

videos.title: Jasmine Ellis: Nobody's Queen
videos.overview: Jasmine Ellis shares her unapologetically hilarious takes on being a newly married millennial and why she could either be the best or worst employee in the world depending on the stars.

videos.title: Jonnie W: Not My Cup of Tea
videos.overview: Jonnie W addresses the Tennessee-born stereotype. Whether or not he matches up to it, his voiced inner monologue is sure to leave you on his side when it comes to new country radio, double decker grave plots, and the difference between fish and beef.

videos.title: John DeBoer: Put it On My Credit Card
videos.overview: His twisted observations of life, the world around him, and particularly how he has managed to screw it up, have earned John a reputation as one of the most consistently strong acts wherever he goes.

videos.title: Michael Palascak: 1984
videos.overview: Michael Palascak started performing stand-up comedy in college but kept it a secret. People would ask, "What are you going to do after you graduate?" He'd say, "I'm pretty sure my parents are taking me out to eat."

videos.title: Helene Angley: Queen Size
videos.overview: Helene brings honesty to the stage that helps everyone relax-- and laugh at the joys and pains of aging, being a married mother of two and all that the generation gap brings!

videos.title: Matthew Jenkins: I Also Have Merch!
videos.overview: Unfortunately, racism is still alive, but Matthew Jenkins has a few ways around it: naming your kid “Case Dismissed;" going to the state penitentiary for a degree; and reversing Simba's fatherless childhood.

videos.title: Nick Arnette: Boomers and Hipsters
videos.overview: LA comic, Nick Arnette, riffs on starting to date grandmas, his border exchange policy, and why Baby Boomers are the coolest generation.

videos.title: Scott Long: Life In Flyover Country
videos.overview: "Scott Long tosses out sharp and clever lines that remind you of the differences between funny people and true comedic artists." –Indy Star

videos.title: Sid Davis: Baggage Claim
videos.overview: This former airline worker hilariously unloads side-splitting baggage on stage. Sid's humor is fueled with A.D.D., a wavering ego, and a grade school teacher wife who views him as a child left behind.

videos.title: Aaron Woodall: Sad And Needy
videos.overview: Between his first and second special, Aaron Woodall's perspective transitioned from "a nice young man coming to grips with a dirty, cynical world" to a deeper introspection of his own upbringing and biases.

videos.title: Brian Bates: Uber Important
videos.overview: Brian Bates worked for nearly 20 years in corporate America before he launched a career in stand up comedy. His experience in the working world gives him a unique perspective on stage that resonates with audiences of all backgrounds

videos.title: Kelly Terranova: A Man Named Kelly
videos.overview: Despite his name, Kelly Terranova isn't a beautiful, witty woman, but what he lacks in luscious flowing locks he makes up for in expressive observational humor.

videos.title: Susan Jones: Lady Ha Ha
videos.overview: Susan Jones is a tenacious headlining comedian, writer, master of ceremonies, and motivational force with national touring experience.

videos.title: Rob Little: Ado-Rob-Ble
videos.overview: Rob Little's outlook on life can be summed up in two words: Pure Optimism. In a recent interview he revealed, "In elementary school, kids would always pull food away from me at lunchtime saying mean, hurtful things like… 'Let go of my sandwich!'"

videos.title: Heather Mabbott: I Didn't Mean To Say That
videos.overview: Her quick wit and unique style has dazzled audiences all over the country. Heather is a clean comedian and has performed with some of the best, like Caroline Rhea, Jimmy Walker, Bobcat Goldthwait, Bruce Baum, Sinbad, and many, many more.

videos.title: Scotty K: Not Country Music
videos.overview: Scotty K proves that he is a jack of all trades, or at least of two: the guitar and comedy. In this set, Scotty refers to everything from Rascal Flatts to Stretch Armstrong. If you miss the "good old days," this is sure to take you back!

videos.title: Jeff Allen: Honor Thy Wife
videos.overview: His Dry Bar Comedy videos have amassed millions of views on social media and other platforms, introducing him to tens of millions of new fans worldwide.

videos.title: Jose Sarduy: Cuban Pilot
videos.overview: Gathering material from a wealth of life experiences, Jose takes audiences on the rollercoaster ride that's been his life.

videos.title: Dwayne Perkins: Dwayne Explains
videos.overview: Dwayne returns to Dry Bar Comedy. If you loved his first special, you will certainly love his 2nd! Dwayne Perkins has earned a spot in today's elite class of stand-up comics with appearances on Comedy Central and on Conan.

videos.title: Armando Anto: The Maestro of Comedy
videos.overview: Armando has been perfecting his unique style of comedy, utilizing his decades of classical violin mastery, his guitar skills, and even breakdance in his act.

videos.title: Daniel Spencer: Dear Amy,
videos.overview: A special special dedicated to a special lady.

videos.title: Brent Terhune: Crooked Ginger
videos.overview: If you're looking for the reason why to use a ladle to eat lucky charms, or why being a Bigfoot hunter is better than being a comedian, your search ends with Brent Terhune, who's "known from time to time, to tell a few jokes."

videos.title: Chris Schlichting: Catch and Dress a Squirrel
videos.overview: Chris Schlichting, an Iowan with every bone in his body still intact, comes with a few crucial warnings. Beware of birthday wishes, day raccoons, and the spelling on all hand written love letters.

videos.title: Glen Tickle: The Favorite
videos.overview: Glen Tickle apologizes for his last name, explains the things only professional comedians have time for, and tells all the stories he's only allowed to tell on stage.

videos.title: Tim Cavanagh: The Joys of UncleDumb
videos.overview: With a companion guitar, Tim cavanagh asks for a wake up call, points out another unhappy marriage, finds a human music stand, and plays a possum game.

videos.title: J Bliss: Ninja Practice
videos.overview: South Jersey originated and a hater of zodiac tattoos, J Bliss pulls his jokes from everyday observations, whether that’s shopping for watches, experiencing gas pump harassment, or trying to differentiate between donkeys and pit bulls.

videos.title: Kenn Kington: Enjoying Chaos
videos.overview: Kenn Kington is losing his patience. As a father and a husband, he's coming to terms with the meaning of “we,” teenage food consumption, and cable’s 900 channels.

videos.title: Mike Gaffney: Dummy Magnet
videos.overview: Frustrated with his life long curse as a dummy magnet, Mike Gaffney complains about doctors with single prescriptions, fit-bits that demand movement to prove life, and children who never move out.

videos.title: Brian Apprille: Jokes & Voices
videos.overview: Brian Apprille is down 153 lbs from Super Morbidly Obese, an overrated super power he blames solely on Homer Simpson. Brian jokes about the endless circle of Pictionary, Dr. Evil's relation to Snape, and a one-time taekwondo class.

videos.title: Brandon Young: Chicken Gone
videos.overview: On the “Bowl Diet” and deciding which chin to put his chin strap on, Brandon Young has 1000 words for any picture, a burned copy of the anti piracy commercial, and a shadow that sets off automatic doors.

videos.title: Seth Knorr: The Correct Answer
videos.overview: Even keeled and skeptical, Seth Knorr graces the stage to wash away any preconceived notions regarding report cards, global warming, and family budgets.

videos.title: Travis Nelson: To Touch a Cloud
videos.overview: Sonya White graces the stage with “buttered-up” jokes and a contagious Southern charm. She shares her love for false-hope TV shows, DIY alarm systems, and Mary Kay motorbikes.

videos.title: Kathleen Dunbar: I've Got a Little Surprise for Ya
videos.overview: From Wisconsin, where people speak backwards, Kathleen Dunbar comes to Dry Bar with a wake up call for anyone 20 and younger, a warning for bra-dialers, and more than a few tips on how to deal with “little demon pig people.”

videos.title: Joey Callahan: The Notorious F.O.D.
videos.overview: A father and husband, Joey Callahan is surrounded by a family of women. Among the growing pains are automatic apologies, inside out catastrophes, and "Jurassic Park" reenactments.

videos.title: Dan Brown: Not Shopping Here today
videos.overview: Dan Brown is a pretty smart idiot. Coming from hillbilly blood, he shares his dungeons and dragons jail-time, batman wedding, and his Pro Wrestling marriage problems.

videos.title: Lisa Gilbert: All the Time Tired
videos.overview: Lisa Gilbert hasn’t had a donut to herself in years. With her new triplets, marriage, and 52nd birthday, Lisa’s personal relationship with herself and Jesus has needed to make some adjustments. Kid leashes and skates; God’s dropbox; and city-approved birthday parties are here new norm.

videos.title: Melvin George: I'm Not Cool
videos.overview: Melvin George, the sequel, is getting older. He’s sleeping separate from his teeth, hearing the sound of God’s laugh, longing for his once long hair, and regretting his childhood decision not to become the first black president.

videos.title: Linda Stogner: Welcome to My Planet
videos.overview: Linda Stogner, a Texas-born cookie attorney, jokes about her Wiener dog who’s now a pug, her family reunion that took place in prison, and her childhood fear of displacing her hip.

videos.title: Matin Atrushi: American Immigrant
videos.overview: Kurdish and playing hard to get, Matin Atrushi is trying to distance himself from his sand-eating dad, his inevitable managerial position at Best Buy, and his stab-worthy Spanish skills.

videos.title: Paul Aldrich: Music & Mirth
videos.overview: Paul Aldrich and his guitar take Dry Bar on a trip around the universe of music for an unforgettable combination of tunes and jokes that will leave you singing kumbaya and a hit song from every decade.

videos.title: Clayburn Cox: Toothbrush Prank War
videos.overview: Born and raised in Alabama, Clayburn Cox makes comedy look easy. He sings a new and improved "Old McDonald," gives the proper answer to “what is your name, sir?” and heckles the audience before they can heckle him.

videos.title: Steve Hofstetter: A Trip to Japan
videos.overview: Often called the "hardest working man in show-business", Steve Hoffstetter covers everything from paper decapitations in plane crashes to seeing-eye children.

videos.title: Dan Mengini: Been There, Dumb That!
videos.overview: Not smart enough to do any more with his overactive brain, Dan Mengini is stuck using plastic, explaining apps to his parents, singing the alphabet to get through the phone book, and dreaming about the life he could’ve had in a third world country.

videos.title: James Gregory: Food is Not Fatal
videos.overview: James Gregory, a Georgian suffering from Vertigo, is on a mission to spread the good news of “real butter,” Paul-bearing strength, hotter summers, and endangered chicken legs.

videos.title: Rob Maher: If You Can Make It Here...
videos.overview: Rob Maher proves that he has the most versatile first name in the English language, that your relationship ended because you didn't spend enough money on wrapping paper, and that being an "accident" is worse than being adopted.

videos.title: Chris Monty: Just Be Happy
videos.overview: Chris Monty would prefer if everyone minded their own business. His is eating a veal chop, working 45 minutes a day, and being next rather than first.

videos.title: Larry Weaver: Law of the Country
videos.overview: Larry Weaver brushes up on the Southern classics: permed corn silk, whisky cough syrup, chocolate tobacco pie, and hillbilly Häagen-Dazs. Apart from endless potlucks, his southern charm has granted him warthog snoring and vegan perdition.

videos.title: Ali Sultan: Third World Energy
videos.overview: Yemeni American, Ali Sultan shares his story of becoming officially American. It is a story full of freedom, superstores, miscommunication, red flags, lots of driving, and a very special place called “Coca La Conca.”

videos.title: Eric Lyden: Any Chance You Didn't Shove That Job Yet?
videos.overview: According to Eric Lyden, all it takes to be a comedian is not being able to do anything else. Regardless, having alternative uses for cork screws, shove-it speeches, and white noise machines can't hurt.

videos.title: Jody Fuller: I'm from Alabama
videos.overview: A lifetime stutterer born and raised in Alabama, Jody Fuller quantifies how many syllables his first word was, people who have finished his sentences, and letters in the alphabet that are best to be avoided.

videos.title: Maureen Langan: Don't Make Me Hate You
videos.overview: Maureen Langan has a wake up call ringing for the young, hot, rich or famous. Luckily for them, she comes with subtitles.

videos.title: Ryan Dalton: Big Heart, Small Brain
videos.overview: A product of the Midwest, Ryan Dalton has found his greatest controversy in street mattresses, dog flights, and events that require emotion.

videos.title: Lisa Alvarado: How to Stay Single
videos.overview: Lisa Alvarado, a single Christian mother, comes to Dry Bar with a plethora of relationship advice. She shares how not to take a selfie, why women get emotional about trash duty, and which biblical coping mechanisms are okay to advertise.

videos.title: Jeff Applebaum: Nut. Free. Zone.
videos.overview: A native New Yorker and MIT educated engineer, Jeff Applebaum navigates life in California, sharing the insanity of his diverse family, inconsistent behavior all around him, and raising children in a "participation trophy" world! It's not anger - it's funny!

videos.title: Paul May: Tickle Fight
videos.overview: Paul May is a God-fearing man with a Tickle Monster complex. Understanding him will take a translator from every decade, but if you want to keep up with the Jones’, attend a Taco Bell wedding, or deposit gerbils at the bank, Paul is your guy.

videos.title: Cyrus Steele: Lazy Eyes Matter
videos.overview: Witty and charming, Cyrus Steele is trying to meal prep during traffic, avoid the lazy eye of the storm, and forgive his mother for putting him in clogging class.

videos.title: Dan Grueter: Cheese & Serial Killers
videos.overview: Dan Grueter is living through the effects of having second thoughts. He is having his own grandchildren, a reassessment of his old neighbor, Jeffrey Dahmer, and a fit about the several strangers rampaging his home.

videos.title: Percy Crews: Old School
videos.overview: With an unrivalable energy, Percy Crews comes to the stage miffed about water bottles, kids these days, scuba diving, and Mexican food.

videos.title: Bill Bunker: I Don't Really Work Here
videos.overview: In his best sports jacket, Bill Bunker shares the joys of driving a loser-decaled minivan, doing B-level homework for his son, and being God’s re-gift to women.

videos.title: Jason Salmon: I'm Sure You Have Some Questions
videos.overview: Both a comedian and an actor, Jason Salmon comes with a plethora of historically accurate jokes. Being extremely white and extremely Texan, Jason’s heritage is either boring or horrific, so he’s currently just making amends.

videos.title: Tom Briscoe: So... I Got Fired From THAT Job
videos.overview: Tom Briscoe, a father and husband, never found his place in the workplace, so he’s left at home playing “Towel Audit” and “What did the doctor say?”. Tom tells the tragic tales of Pigman, the Gluten Free replacement, and the kid with the magnetic head.

videos.title: Killer Beaz: Southern By The Grace Of God
videos.overview: Killer Beaz has spent most of his life in Mississippi, where fantasy vs. reality can become a bit muddled. True or not, the stories of Killer’s comedy career beginning in 5th grade science class or his biggest life change coming from a loose trailer hitch are worth the wonder.

videos.title: Jim McDonald: Work in Progress
videos.overview: Jim McDonald, an Irish man suffering from alcoholic ghosts, is a professional enthusiast. In deciding the difference between rubbish and garbage, or birth control and cargo shorts, Jim’s conclusions go beyond society’s pessimistic tendencies.

videos.title: Casey Peruski: Doing Pretty Good
videos.overview: Casey Peruski, a “Florida boy,” has almost 1000 shows under his belt. Other than comedy, he can decipher church talk, hide his mother’s drinking problem, and use a 6 ft pink flamingo to protect against hurricanes.

videos.title: Andrew Arango Kennedy: Latino In Disguise
videos.overview: Andrew Kennedy lives in ethnic camouflage. Though a Colombian mother and a flawless accent should be proof enough, Andrew tells the story of his life where “looks can be deceiving” is the unsettling truth, and persistent theme.

videos.title: Jeff Leeson: What's the Secret?
videos.overview: Although Jeff Leeson has already achieved his dreams, he joins Dry Bar for an unforgettable night of tuxedo apprentices, undercover comedians, a lemonade stand, and the long sought after secret to everything.

videos.title: John Evans: Goodwill Hunting
videos.overview: Irritated and bored, John Evans has had one too many weird weeks. Married twice for not too long, in the most honest part of his mid-life, and trying to make Easter the new egg style, John’s all for having an audience to explain his less-than-traumatic childhood.

videos.title: Don McMillan: Geek, Nerd or Dork?
videos.overview: In his post-engineering crisis, Don McMillan has taken up comedic PowerPointing. If you want to see an excessively entertaining amount of graphs, charts, and distributions, your search is over.

videos.title: Milt Abel: Remembering Looms and Roombas
videos.overview: A corporate comedian and a family man with quick-witted humor, Milt Abel takes brave leaps into our most anxious thoughts. Where do Roombas escape to? What’s the beyond of Bed Bath and Beyond? When does the firework show end? So many questions…

videos.title: Chas Elstner: Life in the Fast Lane
videos.overview: As graceful and charming as they come, Chas Elstner is a servant to the people: observing human interactions and reporting back with immaculate facial expressions, voices, and soundscapes.

videos.title: Mike Williams: Shut Up! It Was Funny When I Wrote It
videos.overview: Inspiring and endlessly thoughtful, Mike Williams is a family man and an Evangelical comedian. Mike shares his not-so-near death experience, his musical stardom dreams, and his X-ray that brought the entire ER to laughter.

videos.title: Debbie Childers: Sometimes You Gotta Laugh
videos.overview: Having survived 45 years of marriage and car troubles, Debbie Childers is ready to tell her story. As a 65-year-old, God-loving woman, Debbie’s warm charm brings both laughter and lessons.

videos.title: Ken Davis: I'm an Idiot
videos.overview: Ken Davis is a rebel, a germ freak, and a skeptic. From public pranks on his pink moped, to ADHD doctor consultations, Ken’s special wanders to all the places a brain can go in 41 minutes and 12 seconds.

videos.title: Mike Masilotti: Outside Cat
videos.overview: Originally from New York and now residing as a small business owner in Los Angeles, Mike Masilotti is a white anomaly in a family of immigrants. Growing up as a “Mike” in America, he quickly learned that gauges and border passes come with the birth certificate.

videos.title: Chris Franjola: Young Hair Old Face
videos.overview: With a ceaseless grin, Chris Franjola shares the woes of his midlife career. It involves TSA Rechecks, toasting debates, Motel 6 gigs, and all of his front teeth.

videos.title: David Harris: Recalculating
videos.overview: David Harris is a nationally touring, regionally Emmy Award Winning comedian, magician, actor, and host. Harris has entertained North American audiences for over 20 years with over 2000 live performances to date. He regularly appears at clubs, colleges, corporate events, theaters, arts centers, alternative rooms and other top venues across the U.S. and Canada.

videos.title: Landry: Hair Chronicles
videos.overview: Landry's energy is contagious. Coming to the Dry Bar stage with a fresh, bold take on common tropes, he describes the difference between first-class passengers and everyone else; a DUI and an IUD; and Cracker Barrel versus any yard sale.

videos.title: Derrick Tennant: Love Wastefully
videos.overview: The internationally known comedian, speaker, and closet magician, Derrick Tennant travels the world sharing the story of how he overcame overwhelming obstacles to become the leader is he today.

videos.title: Leighann Lord: I Mean Business
videos.overview: Leighann Lord is an American comedian, writer, and actress. She performs stand-up comedy, has appeared on Tough Crowd with Colin Quinn, and is a former co-host (with Neil deGrasse Tyson) of the Star Talk Radio podcast As of April 2020, Lord became a co-host for Center for Inquiry's Point of Inquiry podcast

videos.title: Paul Lyons: You Are Looking at a Winner
videos.overview: Paul Lyons says there's a bright side to everything. Sometimes, it takes looking at life through a dog's perspective, placing guest-proof affirmations throughout the house, or adding your morning nap to your to-do list.

videos.title: Brian Hicks: Weird Mouth Things
videos.overview: The only thing Brian Hicks believes in anymore is shortening the lines at Kohls. Apart from that, Valentine's Day cards can remain unread, dentists can remain mediocre, and the meaning of subdivision names can remain a mystery.

videos.title: Bill Campbell: Getting Up There
videos.overview: Bill Campbell is not as young as he used to be. Egos are lost in translation, contact lenses are replaced by magic markers, and garage sales are negotiated cent-by-cent.

videos.title: Mark Klein: Life Solved
videos.overview: Mark Klein is a middle-aged man from Louisville, Kentucky. He brings with him a short list of bad habits, the five compromises of marriage, the miracle of the free society, and life's most important lesson.

videos.title: Dave Goldstein: Isn't It Obvious?
videos.overview: According to David Goldstein, the only hard part of being full of crap is deciding which direction you'll take it. Any day with a glue gun is a good day, only plumbers and Americans wear pants to spas, and good looks coincide with temperature change.

videos.title: Joe Deuce: Mixed Reviews
videos.overview: Kentucky born and living the best of both worlds, Joe Deuce talks about his encounters with amish police, real-time irony, and toilet paper personality tests.

videos.title: Bryan Miller: Panic Room
videos.overview: Bryan Miller sees past society's traps. The man cave is 1/16 control over the house that you own half of, birth control is just placing your cell phone in the right pocket, and a comma in an income check most likely indicates prosperity.

videos.title: Nikki Carr: I Wish These Were Jokes.
videos.overview: Nikki Carr is 57 and feeling great. After all, she's got the career where all you have to do is be yourself and have a good time . . . two things she subsequently gave up for her goal weight.

videos.title: Bob Smiley: You're Just Hungry
videos.overview: Bob Smiley’s mind races 100 miles per hour. Underwater birth? Maybe not. Giving your enemy’s name out at Prison? Maybe yes. Choosing laughter’s medicine over morphine? Depends on how bad your leg is hurt.

videos.title: Jordan Makin: Comedy in COVID
videos.overview: Jordan Makin delivers the vaccine to the people!

videos.title: Goumba Johnny Sialiano: Comedy in COVID
videos.overview: Goumba Johnny Sialino recaps the chaos and comedy of quarantine.

videos.title: John Moyer: Welcome to My World
videos.overview: John Moyer, and American comedian, is looking to solve the nation’s greatest issues, starting with over-aged drivers, Ambien shopping sprees, and unattended shopping carts.

videos.title: Tony Calabrese: Fugettaboutit!
videos.overview: Tony Calabrese is frustrated with a few things: the Pope isn't Italian, vacations involve movement, and the AARP is the retired mafia.

videos.title: Sonya White: Boot It Up
videos.overview: Sonya White graces the stage with “buttered-up” jokes and a contagious Southern charm. She shares her love for false-hope TV shows, DIY alarm systems, and Mary Kay motorbikes.

videos.title: Joby Saad: Village Idiot
videos.overview: Joby Saad (translation: depressed) grew up in the South with plenty of good-looking cousins. From firsthand experience, Joby is now done with visiting stranger’s homes, lamaze classes, and blockbusters.

videos.title: Leslie Norris Townsend: Outstanding In My Field
videos.overview: Leslie Norris Townsend is having her big night out. Coming straight from her farm in Ohio, Leslie shares her mothering and farming tips, requiring everything from homeless eggs and kids' harnesses, to prayers and plastic surgery.

videos.title: Gid Pool: Welcome to Gid's World
